    Build the static libclang archive for libc++ consumers
    
    Build libclang.a when build_with_libcxx is set, as required by the
    bpftrace static subpackage built from source (bpftrace 7831fb34).
    
    Place LIBCLANG_BUILD_STATIC alongside LLVM_ENABLE_LIBCXX under the
    existing build_with_libcxx condition. Apart from this option, spec
    expansion is identical to the baseline under the default configuration,
    _toolchain_override gcc, _toolchain gcc and undefined _toolchain.
    llvm.spec already forces clang through _toolchain_override when
    _toolchain is defined; this is not a new GCC override guarantee.
    
    Verified by full LLVM RPM builds on armv7l (22 RPMs) and aarch64
    (12 RPMs), with the libclang archives using libc++ symbols and no
    observed std::__cxx11 symbols.

diff --git a/packaging/llvm.spec b/packaging/llvm.spec
index 15a4f7367..75d830e99 100644
--- a/packaging/llvm.spec
+++ b/packaging/llvm.spec
@@ -236,6 +236,7 @@ cmake \
 %if %{defined _toolchain}
 %if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
     -DLLVM_ENABLE_LIBCXX=ON \
+    -DLIBCLANG_BUILD_STATIC=ON \
     -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed" \
     -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed" \
 %else

From 617a210064c4559fe1152728f7c9cf5e1ab99a9f Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Hao Lin <hao.lin@samsung.com>
Date: Wed, 23 Sep 2026 13:25:57 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] Build the static libclang archive for libc++ consumers

Build libclang.a when build_with_libcxx is set, as required by the
bpftrace static subpackage built from source (bpftrace 7831fb34).

Place LIBCLANG_BUILD_STATIC alongside LLVM_ENABLE_LIBCXX under the
existing build_with_libcxx condition. Apart from this option, spec
expansion is identical to the baseline under the default configuration,
_toolchain_override gcc, _toolchain gcc and undefined _toolchain.
llvm.spec already forces clang through _toolchain_override when
_toolchain is defined; this is not a new GCC override guarantee.

Verified by full LLVM RPM builds on armv7l (22 RPMs) and aarch64
(12 RPMs), with the libclang archives using libc++ symbols and no
observed std::__cxx11 symbols.
---
 packaging/llvm.spec | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/packaging/llvm.spec b/packaging/llvm.spec
index 15a4f7367..75d830e99 100644
--- a/packaging/llvm.spec
+++ b/packaging/llvm.spec
@@ -236,6 +236,7 @@ cmake \
 %if %{defined _toolchain}
 %if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
     -DLLVM_ENABLE_LIBCXX=ON \
+    -DLIBCLANG_BUILD_STATIC=ON \
     -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed" \
     -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed" \
 %else
